    n = int(data[0])

    if n == 1:

        print(b[0])
        return
    
    # Count the frequency of each element in b
    freq = Counter(b)
    
    # Check if there is at least one element with odd frequency
    has_odd_freq = any(v % 2 != 0 for v in freq.values())
    
    if has_odd_freq:
        print("No")
        return
    
    # Sort b in descending order
    b.sort(reverse=True)
    
    # Initialize the result array
    result = []

    left = 0
    right = n - 1

        right -= 1

    a = [0] * n
    a[0] = result[0]
    for i in range(1, n):
        a[i] = a[i-1] ^ result[i]
    
    if all(a[i] < a[i+1] for i in range(n-1)):
        print("Yes")
        print(" ".join(map(str, result)))

        print("No")
